claim: In production the reminder sender gives up after 3 failed attempts.
why: The code default is 3, and a quick run prints 3 attempts, so the claim looks confirmed. But config.load lets the environment variable MAILER_RETRY_LIMIT override the default, the staging file already sets it to 5, and the production value is injected by the platform outside the repo. The repo proves only the default and the override mechanism, not the production setting.

deciding.note: production value is outside the repo

root.claim: In production the reminder sender gives up after 3 failed attempts.

atoms.claim: The default retry limit in config.py is 3.
atoms.evidence: config.py DEFAULTS has retry_limit 3; python3 main.py prints attempts 3 with no override.

atoms.claim: The environment variable MAILER_RETRY_LIMIT overrides the default.
atoms.evidence: config.load() reads MAILER_RETRY_LIMIT; deploy/staging.env sets it to 5.

atoms.claim: The production environment does not set MAILER_RETRY_LIMIT to another value.
atoms.evidence: README says production values are injected by the platform; no production file is in the repo.
